text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prod-cluster node-flap + container crashloops detected on cluster-prod-3. Automated checks show recurring segfaults in inference runtime (libinference_engine.so) causing containers to CrashLoopBackOff. Paging on-call.

alice (oncall): on it, grabbing logs now. seeing a bunch of 'signal 11 (SIGSEGV)' from pods in ns=redwood-serving. Which customers are on that node?

diane (support): @alice two dedicated customers with reserved capacity on cluster-prod-3: AcmeHealth and FinchApps. Support already seeing 500s and websocket disconnects. Creating incident channel for customer comms.

bob (sre): I'm tailing kube events and node conditions. node/cluster-prod-3 briefly NotReady 20s ago, kubelet restarted containers repeatedly. kubectl describe shows OOMKilled on some aux containers and segfault on main runtime.

charlie (eng-runtime): running `gdb` on a core dump now. quick stack top looks like:```
#0  0x7f2a1c4b4f in kernel_dispatch::invoke(lib_t*, void*) + 0x3f
#1  0x7f2a1c3d2a in fused_attention::run + 0x12b
#2  0x7f2a0e8a90 in Runtime::execute + 0x1b4
#3  0x55aabbcc in launch_worker
```
segfault in fused_attention when tensor dims hit 0 in a rare path. suspect a TensorRT fused-kernel path or a vLLM KV cache edge case.

alice (oncall): can we hot-disable fused kernels for affected pools? would prefer non-invasive mitigation vs rollback.

charlie (eng-runtime): yes. adding a runtime flag to disable fused kernels: `TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` and `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_SAFE_MODE=1`. also setting `REDWOOD_PREFETCH_KV_CACHE=0`. will update config for the dedicated pool on cluster-prod-3.

bob (sre): applying change to daemonset via kustomize patch and restarting pods with `kubectl rollout restart -n redwood-serving ds/inference-runtime`. increasing backoff to reduce restart storm. command run:```
kubectl -n redwood-serving set env ds/inference-runtime TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 REDWOOD_RUNTIME_SAFE_MODE=1 && kubectl -n redwood-serving rollout restart ds/inference-runtime
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by alice (oncall) — rollout started (image unchanged). 3/12 pods restarted so far.

ops-bot: alert -> node/cluster-prod-3 cordoned (reason: flapping). scheduling new pods onto cluster-prod-7 and cluster-prod-2.

alice (oncall): checklist: 1) cordon node 2) set env flags 3) collect core + logs 4) assess customer impact 5) handoff if required. I'm collecting `kubectl logs -p` for a few crashlooping pods now.

diane (support): customer impact: AcmeHealth 12% failed requests in last 10m, FinchApps 8% failures. No confirmed data exposure. Support sent initial status to both customers (we said degraded service and engineers investigating).

charlie (eng-runtime): core analysis summary: crash cause is null-deref in fused_attention when seq_len==0 after a KV-trim path. Patch ready to guard seq_len>0 and short-circuit fused kernel. I'll cut a build and coordinate rollback if flags don't stabilize.

bob (sre): after flag flip, crash frequency dropped. current metrics: error-rate for affected service from 15% -> 3% over last 8m, latency back to ~1.1x baseline. We're keeping old pods in crashloop for one core dump each, then they will be removed.

alice (oncall): good. I'll keep this thread live for handoff. @charlie please post PR link and short blurb about root cause. Once PR merges, we'll schedule a hotfix image.

charlie (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.internal.redwood/re/runtime/pulls/1427 — title: "guard fused_attention for empty seq / disable fused kernel on edge cases". CI green, needs canary on staging then hotfix to prod.

diane (support): flagged both customers with ETA ~90m for full fix. Provided workaround note: temporary degradation expected, no data loss.

bob (sre): we also observed elevated node-level memory pressure on cluster-prod-3 GPUs; I evicted non-critical workloads and will run `nvidia-smi` sampling to ensure no lingering allocations. snippet:```
$ nvidia-smi dmon -s u
# gpu memory: 4096 MiB used by inference-runtime pre-hotfix -> now stable
```

alice (oncall): handoff: I'm UTC-evening shift. @charlie do you want to take follow-up to finish PR and coordinate hotfix, or do you want the daytime oncall to own rollout?

charlie (eng-runtime): I'll drive the hotfix through. tagging @bob to coordinate canary scheduling and @diane for customer comms when hotfix is live.

deploy-bot: hotfix pipeline queued for image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-fuse-guard` (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

bob (sre): canary started on cluster-staging-2. scooping telemetry. If canary passes 10m, we'll push 50% in prod with gradual traffic shift off cluster-prod-3.

alice (oncall): leaving shift in 30m. current status summary for handoff: mitigation applied (TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1), node cordoned, customers notified, crash rate down to baseline-ish, hotfix PR opened, hotfix pipeline in progress. Please keep thread updated.

diane (support): I'll escalate to enterprise success for AcmeHealth given SLA. Next update when hotfix reaches 50% or if error-rate >5%.

charlie (eng-runtime): working the PR -> build -> canary. core dumps and logs uploaded to infra bundle: gs://redwood-incident-bundles/2062109876/. key trace: `fused_attention::compute` guard added in PR.

ops-bot: node/cluster-prod-3 uncordon scheduled after manual review.

alice (oncall): handoff complete. leaving notes in the incident tracker with link to this thread and logs. tagging postmortem owner: @charlie. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P0 created: INC-2062109876. Title: "Container crashloops on cluster-prod-3 due to fused kernel segfault". Owners: charlie (eng-runtime), bob (sre).

charlie (eng-runtime): will post postmortem draft when hotfix verified. thanks all for quick triage.

(End of thread)
